_comment: Project-scope MCP servers. Checked into git, shared with team. Claude Code prompts for approval the first time it sees a new server here. Add credentials via env vars (NEVER commit secrets).

_postgres_example._comment: EXAMPLE — uncomment + remove the leading underscore to enable. Read-only Postgres access for migration-writer + graphql-feature sub-agents to inspect live schema. Requires DATABASE_URL env var.

_github_example._comment: EXAMPLE — uncomment + remove the leading underscore to enable. GitHub API access for code-reviewer to read PR context, dep-auditor to check published advisories. Requires GITHUB_PAT env var.
